item.title: Dart & Flutter Testing Libraries: flutter_test vs Mocktail vs bloc_test Comparison (2026)
item.description: Testing is the backbone of reliable application development, and the Dart/Flutter ecosystem has matured significantly in its testing tooling. Whether you’re building mobile apps with Flutter or server-side applications with Dart, choosing the right testing library combination dramatically affects your development velocity and code confidence.
